"source" is one id or a list of ids from "sources"; every quote must appear word for word in one of them (homepage, lab, trace, or the file named; public records are copied into docs/case-study-sources/). "values" lists the chart numbers an entry backs; each must be on the page and in a quote. Résumé entries cannot be checked and stay pending-cesar until Cesar confirms them.
